daycontents: Today, try to spend five minutes in silence, away from screens and notifications.
A kind gesture towards someone who does not expect it can change the day for both of you.
Think of something you are grateful for and try to say it to the people who are part of it.
Giving up something unnecessary, even something small, helps make room for what matters.
Today, listen carefully to someone, without interrupting and without thinking about your answer.
The Lenten journey is made of small steps: today's step matters too.
Try to settle a small matter that has been left unresolved.
An unhurried walk can become a moment of reflection.
Today, choose one more kind word and one less criticism.
Think of someone who is going through a difficult time and find a way to let them feel close to you.
Simplicity is a good place to start: today, try to do one thing at a time.
Tidying up outside helps to tidy up inside: choose a small space to put in order.
Today, try to say thank you more often, even for the things you take for granted.
Sharing is a way to feel lighter: is there something you can give to someone in need?
Take a few minutes to write down three good things that happened in the last few days.
Patience is trained one day at a time: today, try not to rush.
A message to someone you have not heard from in a while can make a difference.
Today, stop and look at the sky for a minute: nature is already preparing for spring.
Forgiveness starts with small things: let go of a grudge you no longer need.
Today, try to give up a habit that distracts you, and see what changes.
Every day of the journey is a chance to start again.
Today, offer your time: sometimes it is the most precious gift.
Think about what you would like to take with you at the end of this journey.
A sincere smile costs little and can stay with someone for the whole day.
Rest is part of the journey too: listen to what you need today.
Try to look at a difficult situation through someone else's eyes.
Today, choose to be present: in conversations, at meals, in shared moments.
Simplicity is not deprivation, but freedom from what weighs you down.
Give a thought to the people who helped you become who you are.
Today, try to leave a place a little better than you found it.
Small gestures repeated every day become a way of life.
Silence is not empty: today, try to dwell in it for a few minutes.
Is there someone you owe an apology to? Today may be the right day.
Make room for hope: even after winter, nature blooms again.
Today, try not to complain for a whole day and see how your outlook changes.
Think back on the steps you have taken so far on the journey.
Share a meal, a phone call or a moment with someone who is alone.
Prepare your heart for Easter with a gesture of care for others.
restday_daycontents: Today is a day of rest: take the time to slow down and be with the people you love.
A pause on the journey: enjoy this day calmly.
Today the calendar stops with you. The journey starts again tomorrow.
A day of rest: a chance to look back on the steps taken so far.
No suggestions today: allow yourself a quiet day.
Rest is part of the path too. See you tomorrow with a new thought.
A day to recover energy and serenity before going on.
Today is for resting: give your time to the people and things that make you feel good.
daycontent_first: The journey towards Easter begins. Every day, until Easter Sunday, a box will offer you a small thought: a reflection, a gesture, a moment for yourself.
daycontent_last: It is Easter! The journey is over: thank you for walking it together. Our warmest wishes for a peaceful and happy Easter, to you and to your loved ones.
